evidence: Existing C(C,t) solver and Appendix 4 D(C,T) are retained as the total-moisture baseline.
Uses total C Robin flux as an equivalent surface gasification flux; numerical comparison is real, but liquid/vapor phase split is not measured.
Low/nominal/high bound fractions and release times are transparent sensitivity assumptions; no bound-water inventory or release observation is available.
No independent C_l, C_v, C_b inventories or phase-resolved boundary flux are solved.
The toy only scales the boundary latent heat flux; D(C,T) and the total C equation are not re-added.
Usable only as an explicitly labelled engineering extension/sensitivity, not as an experimentally validated phase model.
